outbound_post.purpose: 发布前内容测量与发布硬闸

outbound_reply.purpose: 我方回复发布前测量、真实性闸与响应对齐

subject_chain.purpose: 真实触达成员响应测量与下游窗口审计
required: subject_chain + response_source, inline or repository path with sha256
subject_chain.success_gate: all response s1 measurements valid; business VERIFIED remains evidence-dependent

fingerprint_policy.scope: UTF-8 bytes of the exact submitted text
fingerprint_policy.rule: any text change requires a new fingerprint and a new submission_id/job_id

outbound_post.reason: s7/s8 anchors and prompts are frozen to this scope

current_adapter_scope.upgrade_rule: another domain/surface/objective requires a versioned measurement adapter and new contract version

audience_policy.prohibited: persona summary or target-population prose presented as audience utterances

output_contract.per_item_artifact: engine outputs plus manifest carrying submission/job/content/profile ids and SHA-256
output_contract.aggregate_artifact: workflow-manifest.json with per-item states; subject profile also emits subject and end-to-end audits
